name: Subconscious noticer — daily Pass A + Pass B scan
notes: Single daily noticer pass (Pass A inward pattern detection + Pass B outward opportunity scouting). run_policy interval=86400 => once per day; the wide 04:00-22:00 local window means it runs at ~04:00 when the machine is on (concerns ready before the 05:00 proposers) but FALLS BACK to the first tick during waking hours if the machine was off overnight, so it no longer silently skips days (it missed 2026-06-06 under the old 1h window). Output: concerns_register + belief_updates + pending_questions + escalations to dayflow.
